title: Slab-built divided trinket dish in air-dry clay
subtitle: A rectangular dish with an internal dividing wall, built from slabs
excerpt: A rectangular two-section trinket dish built from flat slabs of air-dry clay. An internal dividing wall separates the dish into two compartments suitable for rings and earrings. No kiln is required.
sourceNotes: Technique derived from first principles. Slab-building methods referenced from Encyclopedia Britannica 11th edition (1911) pottery entry.

glossaryTerms.definition: A flat sheet of clay rolled to an even thickness, used as the building unit in slab construction
The drying stage where clay holds its shape but is still damp enough to join and refine
Clay thinned with water to a paste used as adhesive between clay pieces

content.text: A divided trinket dish sorts a dressing table at a glance: one side for earrings, one for rings. The
construction is straightforward: a base rectangle, four wall strips, and one internal divider. No kiln is required.
Roll a slab 6 mm thick. Cut a base rectangle 16 cm by 8 cm.
Cut two long side walls 16 cm by 3 cm and two short end walls 8 cm by 3 cm from the same slab.
Cut one dividing wall 8 cm by 3 cm. This sits across the middle of the dish parallel to the short end walls.
Allow all pieces to firm to
to the bottom edge of each wall piece and the corresponding area on the base. Press each wall in place, holding for 30 seconds.

Score and slip the base of the divider and the base rectangle at the halfway point. Press the divider in at a 90-degree angle to the long walls. Reinforce all inside joins with a thin coil of soft clay smoothed into the corner.
Smooth all outside joins with a damp sponge. Allow to dry flat to
Apply two coats of PVA. Paint with acrylics or leave natural. Stick felt pads to the underside to protect shelves.
Add two dividers to create three sections. Press a leaf or stamp texture into the base slab before cutting.

items.cause: The wall strip was too thin or the inside join coils were too small to hold the angle
items.fix: Press a short rolled coil of soft clay into the inside corner and smooth flat. Support the outside of each wall with a card prop while leather-hard

items.problem: Base warps upward at the corners
items.cause: The base dried faster on the top surface than the underside
items.fix: Once the walls are stable at leather-hard, flip the dish upside down. Let the base underside dry for an hour, then return the dish to upright.
